en.title: Rio de Janeiro confirms first mpox death in the country
en.dek: The state of Rio de Janeiro confirmed the first mpox death in the nation this week
facts: The state of Rio de Janeiro confirmed the first mpox death in the country
The Secretariat of Health registered 382 mpox cases in 2026 up to Friday, November 13
The municipality of Rio de Janeiro concentrated 71.2% of the state's mpox registrations
The Ministry of Health announced on November 8 the acquisition of 25,000 mpox vaccine doses
body: The state of Rio de Janeiro confirmed the first mpox death in the country this week, and the victim was from the capital
The Secretariat of Health of Rio de Janeiro reported that more than two thousand doses were made available for the state, and the vaccination schedule requires two doses separated by 28 days
The average age of infected patients was 33.8 years, and the Secretariat of Health noted that lesions are more frequent on the face, palms, and soles
The Mpox virus (MPXV) is an infectious disease that causes symptoms such as skin and mucous lesions, fever, and headaches
en.context: The Mpox virus (MPXV) causes symptoms including skin and mucous lesions, fever, and body aches, according to the source

de.title: Rio de Janeiro meldet ersten Mpox-Todesfall im Land
de.dek: Der Bundesstaat Rio de Janeiro bestätigte diese Woche den ersten Mpox-Todesfall im Land
facts: Der Bundesstaat Rio de Janeiro bestätigte den ersten Mpox-Todesfall im Land
Das Gesundheitssekretariat verzeichnete bis Freitag, den 13. November, 382 Mpox-Fälle im Jahr 2026
Die Stadt Rio de Janeiro verzeichnete 71,2 % der Mpox-Registrierungen des Bundesstaates
Das Gesundheitsministerium kündigte am 8. November die Beschaffung von 25.000 Mpox-Impfstoffdosen an
body: Der Bundesstaat Rio de Janeiro bestätigte diese Woche den ersten Mpox-Todesfall im Land, die betroffene Person stammte aus der Hauptstadt.

Das Gesundheitssekretariat von Rio de Janeiro meldete, dass über zweitausend Dosen für den Bundesstaat zur Verfügung gestellt wurden und der Impfplan zwei Dosen mit einem Abstand von 28 Tagen erfordert.
Das Durchschnittsalter der infizierten Patienten betrug 33,8 Jahre, und das Gesundheitssekretariat wies darauf hin, dass Läsionen häufiger im Gesicht, an Handflächen und Fußsohlen auftreten.
Das Mpox-Virus (MPXV) ist eine Infektionskrankheit, die Symptome wie Haut- und Schleimhautläsionen, Fieber und Kopfschmerzen verursacht.
de.context: Das Mpox-Virus (MPXV) verursacht Symptome wie Haut- und Schleimhautläsionen, Fieber und Gliederschmerzen, so die Quelle

fr.title: Rio de Janeiro confirme le premier décès par mpox dans le pays
fr.dek: L'État de Rio de Janeiro a confirmé ce week-end le premier décès par mpox dans la nation
facts: L'État de Rio de Janeiro a confirmé le premier décès par mpox dans le pays
Le Secrétariat de la Santé a enregistré 382 cas de mpox en 2026 jusqu'au vendredi 13 novembre
La municipalité de Rio de Janeiro a concentré 71,2 % des enregistrements de mpox de l'État
Le Ministère de la Santé a annoncé le 8 novembre l'acquisition de 25 000 doses de vaccin contre le mpox
body: L'État de Rio de Janeiro a confirmé ce week-end le premier décès par mpox dans le pays, la victime résidant dans la capitale.
Le Secrétariat de la Santé de Rio de Janeiro a indiqué que plus de deux mille doses avaient été mises à disposition pour l'État, et le calendrier vaccinal requiert deux doses espacées de 28 jours.
L'âge moyen des patients infectés était de 33,8 ans, et le Secrétariat de la Santé a noté que les lésions sont plus fréquentes sur le visage, les paumes et les plantes.
Le virus Mpox (MPXV) est une maladie infectieuse provoquant des symptômes tels que des lésions cutanées et muqueuses, de la fièvre et des maux de tête.
fr.context: Le virus Mpox (MPXV) provoque des symptômes incluant des lésions cutanées et muqueuses, de la fièvre et des douleurs corporelles, selon la source

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and is not under 90 characters.
The dek attributes the confirmation to Agência Brasil, but the source states the state confirmed it, not Agência Brasil directly.
The first fact incorrectly dates the confirmation to November 15, 2026; the source states it was confirmed 'this week' and the date of the report is November 15, 2026.
The third fact attributes the announcement date to November 8, but the source only states the announcement was made on that date, not that the acquisition happened then.
The fourth fact attributes the symptoms to Agência Brasil, but the source describes the virus and its symptoms generally.
The first body sentence attributes the confirmation to Agência Brasil, but the source states the state confirmed it.
The second body sentence attributes the availability of doses to the Secretariat of Health of Rio de Janeiro, which is correct, but the phrasing needs tightening.
The third body sentence attributes the concentration of registrations and average age to Agência Brasil, but the source provides this data from the Secretariat of Health.

The fourth body sentence introduces information about São Paulo (futebol festival) which is irrelevant to the mpox topic and violates the principle that every sentence must add information relevant to the core subject (mpox in Rio de Janeiro).
The context sentence attributes the description of the virus to Agência Brasil, but the source provides this information generally.
The structure does not adhere to the required paragraph length and flow (e.g., no variation in sentence length, no avoidance of four short declarative sentences in a row).
